newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH LEAGUE FIXTURES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH LEAGUE FIXTURES.

text.p: English and Scottish league fixtures for September 21-23:

Premier league - Aston Villa v Manchester United, Blackburn v Everton, Leeds v Newcastle, Liverpool v Chelsea, Middlesbrough v Arsenal, Nottingham Forest v West Ham, Sheffield Wednesday v Derby, Sunderland v Coventry.

Division one - Bradford City v Bolton, Grimsby v Oxford, Manchester City v Birmingham, Oldham v Barnsley, Portsmouth v Norwich, Queens Park Rangers v Swindon, Reading v Crystal Palace, Southend v Port Vale, Tranmere v West Bromwich, Wolverhampton v Sheffield United.

Division two - Bournemouth v Notts County, Blackpool v Shrewsbury, Bristol City v Walsall, Bury v Luton, Chesterfield v Burnley, Gillingham v Rotherham, Millwall v Crewe, Plymouth v Bristol Rovers, Watford v Peterborough, Wrexham v Preston, Wycombe v Brentford, York v Stockport.

Division three - Barnet v Exeter, Brighton v Torquay, Cambridge United v Scarborough, Cardiff v Northampton, Carlisle v Darlington, Chester v Scunthorpe, Doncaster v Swansea, Fulham v Mansfield, Hereford v Rochdale, Hull v Hartlepool, Leyton Orient v Colchester, Wigan v Lincoln.
Scottish premier division - Aberdeen v Hibernian, Celtic v Dunfermline, Hearts v Motherwell, Kilmarnock v Rangers, Raith v Dundee United
Division one - Airdrieonians v Parktick, Clydebank v St Johnstone, Dundee v East Fife, St Mirren v Falkirk, Stirling v Greenock Morton
Division two - Berwick v Dumbarton, Brechin v Hamilton, Queen of South v Ayr, Stenhousemuir v Livingston, Stranaraer v Clyde
Division three - Albion v Alloa, Cowdenbeath v Ross County, East Stirling v Montrose, Forfar v Arbroath, Inverness Thistle v Queen's Park
